rows.details: Indian Institute of Information Technology, Design and Manufacturing (IIITDM) Kancheepuram
Initially one (1) year; extension possible on yearly basis

content_sections.heading: About IIITDM Kancheepuram
content_sections.text: IIITDM Kancheepuram is an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. Its address is Melakottaiyur Village, Off Vandalur–Kelambakkam Road, Nellikuppam, Chennai – 600 127, Tamil Nadu. The Institute caters to the medical and healthcare needs of its students, faculty, staff and their families residing within the campus.

content_sections.heading: Post Details
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications from suitably qualified, retired or experienced doctors who can provide dedicated medical care.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Familiarity with management of a campus dispensary / health centre, basic diagnostics, maintenance of medical records and health-related administrative coordination. The notice gives a minimum age of above 45 years and a maximum age of 63 years. The application form asks for the age as on the closing date of application. The notice lists no age relaxation.

rows.qualification: MBBS degree from a Medical College / University recognised by the National Medical Commission (NMC) / erstwhile Medical Council of India (MCI), with a valid and current registration with the State Medical Council / Indian Medical Register
rows.experience: Minimum 10 (ten) years of post-qualification experience in clinical practice / general medicine in a recognised hospital or institutional health centre

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Honorarium: ₹ 2,500/- per visit (Rupees two thousand five hundred only). Duty hours: Monday to Friday, 05:00 PM to 07:00 PM (2 hours), at the Institute Health Centre. Tenure: the engagement is initially for one (1) year. Based on satisfactory performance and continued requirement, the contract may be extended on a yearly basis for a further period. Continuation or extension is at the sole discretion of the Institute and subject to annual review of performance, conduct and medical fitness. The engagement is purely temporary and on contract basis. It does not confer any right or claim for regularisation or absorption into the regular establishment of the Institute.

content_sections.heading: IIITDM Kancheepuram Lady Medical Officer (LMO) Job Description
content_sections.text: Providing primary medical care, consultation, diagnosis and treatment to female students, faculty and staff and their family members at the campus Health Centre. The notice lists these as indicative duties and responsibilities.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIITDM Kancheepuram Lady Medical Officer (LMO)
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates may submit their application in the format attached to the notice by e-mail to [email protected] . The application must reach the Institute on or before 10 December 2026. Fill in the application format attached to the notice (Application for the position of Lady Medical Officer (LMO) on contract at IIITDM Kancheepuram), with a recent passport-size photograph affixed. Attach copies of certificates relating to qualification, NMC / State Medical Council registration, experience and date of birth, and a recent passport-size photograph. Write the subject line as: “Application for the post of Lady Medical Officer (On Contract)”. E-mail the application to [email protected] so that it reaches the Institute by 10 December 2026. The application form asks for name and address for correspondence in block letters, mobile number, e-mail address, Aadhaar card number, PAN number, date of birth and age as on the closing date, hospital or organisation served now or last, designation, medical degree qualifications, NMC / State Medical Council registration details, employment details in chronological order, additional information, awards or prizes, and a signed declaration. The Institute lists phone numbers 044-2747 6312 / 6300 on its letterhead. Selection will be made on the basis of an interview / interaction before a duly constituted Selection Committee. Only shortlisted candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria will be called for the interview. Mere fulfilment of the minimum eligibility does not confer any right to be shortlisted or selected. Candidates called for interview must bring all original certificates / documents for verification along with one set of self-attested photocopies. No TA / DA will be paid for attending the interview. The notice does not give an interview date or venue.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed format, signed with declaration. Copies of certificates relating to qualification. Copy of NMC / State Medical Council registration. Copies of experience certificates. Date of birth proof. Recent passport-size photograph. For interview, if called: all original certificates / documents and one set of self-attested photocopies.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The candidate must be medically fit to perform the duties of the post and shall, if required, produce a medical fitness certificate. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. Incomplete applications, applications without supporting documents, or those received after the last date are liable to be rejected. If any information is found false, incorrect or incomplete, or ineligibility is detected at any time before or after selection, the candidature is liable to be rejected. Any dispute arising out of this engagement is subject to the jurisdiction of courts at Chennai, Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q1. How many Lady Medical Officer posts are vacant at IIITDM Kancheepuram?
faq.answer: The notice announces 01 (One) post of Lady Medical Officer (LMO), purely on contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IIITDM Kancheepuram LMO recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date is 10 December 2026. The application must reach the Institute by that date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IIITDM Lady Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: An MBBS degree from a medical college or university recognised by NMC / erstwhile MCI, with valid and current State Medical Council / Indian Medical Register registration, and at least 10 years of post-qualification experience in clinical practice / general medicine.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIITDM LMO post?
faq.answer: The minimum age is above 45 years and the maximum age is 63 years.

faq.answer: Send the application in the attached format by e-mail to [email protected], with copies of the required certificates and a passport-size photograph, so that it reaches the Institute by 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What should be the subject line of the application e-mail?
faq.answer: The subject line is “Application for the post of Lady Medical Officer (On Contract)”.

faq.question: Q8. How will the Lady Medical Officer be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is by interview / interaction before a Selection Committee. Only shortlisted candidates who meet the eligibility criteria are called.

faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely temporary and on contract basis. It is initially for one year and may be extended yearly at the Institute's sole discretion, with no right to regularisation.
